title: 2 Wherefore we deſire, that gods will be done.

segments.text: THIS petition is neceſſarie, 1. That the kingdome of god maie come, vvhereof vvee ſpake in the ſecond petition. For except god himſelfe bring to paſſe, that euerie one in his calling & duetie doe diligently his vvill, this kingdome cannot be ſetled, floriſh, and be preſerued. 2. That we maie be in this kingdome. For except vve doe the vvill of god, vve cannot be citizens of his kingdome. And vve are not able of our ſelues, by reaſon of the corruption of our nature, to doe his vvill. Therefore vvee muſt deſire of him that vvee may doe it.
